BiblicalUsage: Beth-Anath means "house of response (or affliction)." It was a place in Naphtali. It turns up in Joshua 19:38 and Judges 1:33.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Beth-Anath is a real place God named, part of the land He gave His people.
